title: Preview or send the Todo daily attention digest
summary: Preview the email grouping pending concerns and open todos by the attention they need, or send it now through the configured Resend account.
use_when: The exact currently configured daily attention digest should be previewed locally.
The user explicitly wants the current daily attention digest sent now through Resend.
do_not_use_when: A local Todo list or stage-specific inspection is sufficient.
External disclosure of the digest's titles, attention labels, typed references, and counts has not been authorized.
The request is to test Nucleus, a model liaison, or future remote scheduling.
outcome: An exact local preview or one idempotent immediate Resend submission of the current Todo daily attention digest.
effects: Preview reads Todo state and renders headers plus plain text and HTML without reading the API key or using the network.
Send freezes the digest, reads `RESEND_API_KEY`, and submits it immediately to Resend with a stable invocation-specific key.
Scheduled mode changes the idempotency key to the most recent local 09:00 occurrence; it does not submit a remote scheduled-at value.
authority: Todo owns the current digest projection and installed sender/recipient configuration.
Resend owns external submission and delivery records; the recipient provider owns final receipt.
success: Preview exactly identifies the configured sender, recipient, subject, attention count, pending-concern count, open-todo count, and current body without network access.
Send reports Resend acceptance under the frozen idempotency key.
External receipt is confirmed separately when delivery rather than submission is the required outcome.
failure_and_recovery: Transport, rate-limit, and server failures are retried only within the command's bounded three-attempt policy using the same frozen body and key.
There is no Todo delivery table or background retry queue; inspect Resend and installed logs after command failure.
A manual send does not consume the scheduled occurrence's key.
privacy: Sending discloses aggregate counts, every open canonical todo's current title, generic plain-language stage labels, applicable typed references, and read-only inspection commands to Resend and the configured recipient's email provider.
The digest excludes concern bodies, directions, notes, source paths, assessment and design summaries, unresolved-choice text, and evidence.
The API key remains environment-only and must not be stored in Todo configuration, command arguments, or launchd plist.
does_not_authorize: External sending when only preview was requested.
Changing configured sender, recipient, or Resend account.
Treating email preview or delivery as a Nucleus requester canary.

consumers.statement: The configured current user may preview the exact Todo attention digest locally or explicitly submit it through the configured email path.
A generic Todo listing, Nucleus canary, remote scheduler, delivery ledger, or implicit external-disclosure consumer is outside this capability.

preconditions.statement: Preview requires a selected Todo database and complete installed sender and recipient configuration.
Send additionally requires explicit external-disclosure authority, a nonblank whitespace-clean RESEND_API_KEY in the process environment, and a Resend-verified sender domain.

inputs.statement: The projection reads current unresolved concerns, open canonical todos, and configured sender and recipient; send accepts only the optional scheduled-mode selector.
Future scheduled_at timestamps, arbitrary recipients, stored API keys, custom message bodies, and Nucleus model inputs are unsupported.

outputs.statement: Preview returns configured From, To, subject, attention, pending-concern and open-todo counts, and exact plain-text and HTML bodies without network access.
Send returns Resend submission acceptance for one frozen message and idempotency key; recipient receipt is a separate external outcome.

data_semantics.statement: Needs your decision, Needs follow-up, and Other open todos are current derived attention groups; empty groups are omitted and accepted desired state does not imply implemented work.

The digest includes aggregate counts, titles or plain-language labels, typed references, and read-only inspection commands while excluding concern bodies, directions, notes, paths, detailed assessments or designs, choices, and evidence.

identity_and_units.statement: attention_count counts items in the first two attention groups, pending_concern_count counts unresolved captured concerns, and todo_count counts open canonical tN umbrellas.
Manual idempotency keys use todo-email/<UUIDv7>; scheduled keys use todo-daily-email/<local YYYY-MM-DD> for the most recent machine-local 09:00 occurrence.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Each invocation derives one current projection from every unresolved captured concern and every open canonical Todo record visible in the selected database, then freezes the body and key before send attempts.
A successful submission does not prove final receipt, and the user LaunchAgent cannot guarantee a 09:00 submission while the machine is off or the user is logged out.

access.statement: Preview is a local current-user read that does not read the API key; send reads the key from process environment and calls the configured Resend endpoint.
Todo exposes no credential storage, recipient mutation, delivery database, background retry queue, or implicit send path.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: One send invocation freezes its body and idempotency key and uses them for at most three total attempts on transport, rate-limit, or server failure.
Manual and scheduled invocations use distinct key spaces, no digest state is committed to Todo SQLite, and a failed command has no Todo-owned later retry lifecycle.

operational_limits.statement: Retries are bounded to three total attempts, sending is immediate, and the user-owned daily schedule is one machine-local 09:00 LaunchAgent occurrence without RunAtLoad.
No Resend quota, recipient-provider latency, delivery deadline, perpetual retention, or maximum digest-size service-level objective is promised.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Capability contract version 2 distinguishes local preview, immediate send, and local-occurrence scheduled mode while keeping sender, recipient, and API-key ownership explicit.
No compatibility window for future digest schemas, Resend APIs, email-provider behavior, or external retention policies is promised.

reliances.statement: External send relies on Resend for API acceptance and submission records, but no dedicated installed Chancery contract describes that service promise.
Final recipient receipt is outside this submission-acceptance promise and must be confirmed separately when delivery is the required outcome.
Automatic daily invocation relies on per-user launchd supervision, but no dedicated installed Chancery contract describes launchd readiness.
